# Vacationist Web App

> This is the Vacationist web app (web.vacationist.app) — sign in and use Vacationist in a browser. For product information, features, pricing, and comparisons, see the marketing site links below.

Vacationist is a free group trip planning app for Android and web. Groups vote on activities, split expenses with live balances, share real-time packing/shopping lists, and store travel documents in an AES-256 encrypted vault. Most pages on this origin require a signed-in session and are not useful to crawl directly.

## Links

- [Vacationist marketing site](https://vacationist.app/): Full product information, features, pricing, and blog.
- [Vacationist marketing llms.txt](https://vacationist.app/llms.txt): Structured summary for LLMs — features, use cases, comparisons, and URLs.
- [Sign in](https://web.vacationist.app/login): Sign in to the web app.
- [Android app on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vacationist.mobile): Free Android download.
